description: Backend job calling the proxy over HTTP (summaries, classification, extraction). Independent single requests, non-streaming, medium input, short output.
assumptions: Each session is a single request (no conversation).
Input ~1500 tokens median (a document chunk), output ~120 tokens.
Arrivals are Poisson; batch bursts are modelled by raising rateMultiplier.
Never streams; gives up after 30 s.
